# `browser`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] browser`

Control a local Chromium/Chrome window (CDP). Actions: status, open, snapshot, click, type, wait, screenshot, close. Not in the core tool profile — use tool_search. The OS sandbox does not apply; domain allowlists do not apply inside the browser. Permission defaults to ask.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `status`, `open`, `snapshot`, `click`, `type`, `wait`, `screenshot`, `close` | yes | Browser action |
| `ms` | integer | no | Wait milliseconds (default 1000) |
| `selector` | string | no | CSS selector for click/type |
| `text` | string | no | Text to type |
| `url` | string | no | URL for open |
